# Rapid House Buyer

> Direct cash property buyers purchasing residential properties across all London boroughs and within the M25. Same-day valuations, 24-hour exchange, zero fees.

## About

Rapid House Buyer is a privately funded direct cash buyer operating since 2012. NAPB member, TPO registered. We purchase any residential property in any condition for cash — no fees, no chains, no delays.

- Phone: +44 20 7199 1698
- Email: enquiries@rapidhousebuyer.co.uk
- Address: 30 St Mary Axe, London EC3A 8BF
- Coverage: All 32 London boroughs and M25 corridor

## Services

- [How It Works](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/how-it-works): Our 4-step cash buying process
- [Repossession](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/repossession): Stop repossession with a fast cash sale
- [Probate](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/probate): Inherited and probate property sales
- [Landlords](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/landlords): BTL portfolio and HMO exits
- [Debt](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/debt): Sell to resolve debt or financial difficulty
- [Divorce](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/divorce): Discreet property sales during separation
- [Urgent Sale](https://rapidhousebuyer.co.uk/pages/urgent-sale): Exchange in 24 hours
